outline:
本課程介紹X射線特性、繞射原理及X射線繞射在材料科學上之應用。內容包括X射線之產生，X射線之性質，X射線之繞射理論，材料之晶體結構與繞射條件。在X射線繞射方法方面則介紹Laue照相法，粉末法，繞射儀及光譜儀等。應用方面則包括晶體結構之鑑定，晶格常數之量測，相圖測定，序化一非序化轉換及化學成分分析等。
Introduction to the following topics:
1. Properties of X-Ray
2. Geometry of Crystals
3. Principles of X-Ray Diffraction
4. Experimental Methods
(Diffractometer Measurements, Powder Photographs, and Laue Photographs)
5. Applications of X-ray Diffraction on Materials Science
(Orientation and Quality of Single Crystal, Determine of Crystal Structure and Precise Parameter Measurements, Chemical Analysis, Phase Transformations etc.)
